data.hop_ownership: Look up who runs each hop

data_description.hop_ownership: Off by default. Shows the network operator (ASN) of each public hop. Sends those hop addresses (your ISP's routers, not your own address) to Team Cymru's free IP-to-ASN service, through your DNS server. Private and shared ISP addresses have no owner and are never sent.
